# JOELL (Journal of English Language and Literature)

> > A peer-reviewed open-access academic journal publishing scholarly research on English language, literature, linguistics, and related fields.

JOELL is an established academic journal by Veda Publications that publishes original research articles, literary criticism, and language studies from scholars across India and internationally. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards and welcomes submissions on diverse topics including postcolonial literature, English language teaching, Dalit studies, and contemporary literary analysis.

## Key Topics

## Getting Started

- [Journal of English Language and Literature[JOELL]](https://www.joell.in): Homepage for JOELL, a peer-reviewed open-access academic journal by Veda Publications
- [Submission Guidelines](https://www.joell.in/submission): Manuscript submission guidelines and formatting requirements for JOELL authors
- [Author Guidelines](https://www.joell.in/29-2): Editorial standards and author guidelines for JOELL manuscript submissions
- [Publishing Ethics](https://www.joell.in/publishing-ethics): Publishing ethics and peer-review policies for JOELL including open peer review

## Current & Recent Issues

- [Vol.12, Issue 1, 2025](https://www.joell.in/vol-12-issue-1-2025): Current journal issue featuring articles on ESL, literature, and language studies
- [Vol.11, Issue 4, 2024](https://www.joell.in/vol-11-issue-4-2024): Vol.11 Issue 4 with literary analysis and linguistics studies including Atwood criticism
- [Vol.11, Issue 3, 2024](https://www.joell.in/vol-11-issue-3-2024): Vol.11 Issue 3 covering postcolonial literature and English language education research
- [Volume 11, Issue 2, 2024](https://www.joell.in/volume-11-issue-2-2024): Vol.11 Issue 2 with literary analysis on contemporary fiction and cultural studies
- [Vol.11, Issue 1, 2024](https://www.joell.in/vol-11-issue-1-2024): JOELL Vol.11 Issue 1 featuring articles on ESL, literature, and language education
- [Vol. 11, Spl. Issue 1, 2024](https://www.joell.in/vol-11-spl-issue-1-2024): Special issue on English language teaching and conference proceedings from 2024

## 2023 Archives

- [Vol.10, Issue 4, 2023](https://www.joell.in/vol-10-issue-4-2023): Vol.10 Issue 4 featuring English language and literature research with linguistic studies
- [Vol.10, Issue 3, 2023](https://www.joell.in/vol-10-issue-3-2023): Vol.10 Issue 3 with literary analysis of Indian authors and comparative literature
